cards.text: Ezekiel, a priest living among the exiles in Babylon, is seeing a vision of a new temple (Ezekiel 1:1-3; 40:2). A man who looks like bronze has been walking him through it, gate by gate (Ezekiel 40:3). Now the Lord GOD speaks, starting with the gate of the inner court that faces east.

cards.question: The Lord GOD says the inner court's east gate stays shut during the six days of work. So when does it open?

answers.text: On the Sabbath and the New Moon
On Passover and the Day of Atonement
At the start of every harvest

cards.text: In comes the prince, who provides the offerings for the feasts, New Moons and Sabbaths (Ezekiel 45:17). He enters from outside through the gateway's portico and stands by the gatepost.

cards.question: The prince stands by the gatepost while the ___ sacrifice his burnt offerings and peace offerings.
Before the prince departs, what does he do at the threshold of the gate?
On the Sabbath, once the prince departs, the east gate gets shut right away.
On Sabbaths and New Moons, the ___ of the land also bow in worship before the LORD at the entrance to the inner court's east gate.

cards.text: Next comes the offering list: six lambs and a ram on the Sabbath, and on the New Moon a young bull too, all without blemish. Grain and oil go with them, and with the lambs the prince gives as much as he is able, which is EXACTLY how I measure chocolate chips.
When the prince goes in through the gateway's portico, he goes out the same way. At the appointed feasts, the people of the land come before the LORD to worship too.

cards.question: At the appointed feasts, a worshiper comes in by the north gate. Which gate does he leave by?

cards.text: Nobody goes back out the gate he came in by: in north, out south, in south, out north. It's a one-way hallway, and baker, I have BEEN the guy walking against the whole crowd, mustache first, apologizing to everybody.

cards.question: At the appointed feasts, the prince goes in with the people and leaves when they leave.

cards.text: At the festivals and appointed feasts, the grain and oil offerings follow the same pattern as the New Moon. Same recipe, different day, friend, and that is my FAVORITE kind of recipe.
Now say the prince brings a freewill offering to the LORD, a burnt offering or a peace offering. He offers it just as he does on the Sabbath.

cards.question: For the prince's freewill offering, the gate facing east is opened for him.

cards.text: After he goes out, the gate is closed. Then comes a permanent rule for every morning: an unblemished year-old lamb as a burnt offering to the LORD, with a grain offering of fine flour moistened with oil. Regular as an alarm clock, friend, except nobody gets to hit snooze on this one.
Now the Lord GOD talks about the prince's land, starting with what happens when he gives a gift to one of his sons as an inheritance.

cards.question: If the prince gives a gift to one of his sons as an inheritance, it will belong to his ___ as their property.
But say the prince gives a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants instead. What happens to it in the year of freedom?

answers.text: It goes back to the prince
It passes to the servant's sons

cards.text: Back to the prince it goes. His inheritance belongs only to his sons.

cards.question: The prince may take the people's land by evicting them, so he can give it to his sons.
The prince has to give his sons an inheritance from his own property. What does the Lord GOD say this rule is for?

answers.text: So none of His people are displaced from their property
So the prince's sons never argue over who gets the land
So the land around the temple can keep growing larger

cards.text: Then the man guiding Ezekiel brings him through a side entrance into the holy chambers facing north, the ones that belonged to the priests. There, at the far western end, he shows him a place.

cards.question: The man shows Ezekiel a place at the far western end of the priests' holy chambers. What is that place for?

cards.text: The priests boil the guilt offering and the sin offering here, and they BAKE the grain offering. Baker, I heard that word and my mustache shot straight up like a guy at the DMV finally hearing his number called.

cards.question: The priests cook the guilt, sin and grain offerings at the western end of their holy chambers so they don't bring them into the outer court and transmit holiness to the people.

cards.text: Then the man leads Ezekiel around the outer court, and in each of its four corners is a separate enclosed court, all the same size. Each one has ovens built along the base of its walls. The man tells him these are the kitchens where those who minister at the temple will cook the sacrifices offered by the people. Four matching kitchens, friend, and I can't even get four scoops of dough the same size.
And that's where I'll set the timer for now, friend, because this vision is NOT finished yet.
